brief: Pots on my balcony for three hot chilli pepper seedlings.

requirements.requirement: Three pots, one for each seedling

requirements.evidence: prop:1,2,3 are pepper-seedling (Sweet pepper label, fruiting, seedling stage). No hot chilli prop exists in catalog; used closest pepper seedling.

3-cell triangle on pieces 0,0 1,0 0,1 with drained bins; check_build ok, meshClash clear. Configurator does not check materials, strength, waterproofing or UV resistance — parts are 3D printed in user-chosen material.

finish.summary: Built a compact 3-cell triangle with 3 full-depth drained bins, each filled with soil and planted with a pepper seedling. No hot-chilli-specific prop exists so sweet-pepper seedlings stand in for them; balcony weatherproofing/material suitability is unverified.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
